## Changes since 9.3.0-dzbarsky35

- Backport [#68](https://github.com/dzbarsky/bazel/pull/68): `RemoteExecutionCache` now checks the action filesystem’s delegate before uploading inputs. External source files can exist only in the remote repository-cache overlay; checking bare disk incorrectly treated them as lost action inputs and could crash while converting their paths relative to the exec root.
- Preserve generated-input recovery and let the repository overlay record cache eviction, invalidate the affected repository, and refetch it on the next build.

### Validation

`RemoteTests` and `remote_repo_contents_cache_test` passed uncached on Linux remote execution against the release branch and the upstream port, including the new virtual-file upload and eviction/refetch regressions. A transient missing remote-cache artifact required a build retry. All 21 immutable-release publication checks passed.

Linux and macOS prebuilts for x86_64 and arm64 are built and version-checked before immutable publication, with SHA-256 checksums and build-provenance records. Existing release tags and assets are preserved.
